svg.title: Multilingual greetings
svg.desc: An anime character in a pearlescent browser window with animated multilingual greetings.
svg.metadata: Greeting data adapted from English Wiktionary contributors, entry “hello”: https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/hello#Translations. Extracted by Kaikki/Wiktextract: https://kaikki.org/dictionary/English/meaning/h/he/hello.jsonl. Greeting selection and order were adapted.
